loyaltyPerFrame.rule: Fctcnt - 1 every frame while Fctcnt > 0, floored at 0; the warnings print at exactly 20000, 10000 and 5000 after the decrement, and at 1 the player is kicked (Fctnme, Fctcnt and the bonuses 0, LeaveGroup @Faction, save)

headDrop.rule: On RunDeathScript after the arena exit and before the DropOnDeath item or gold: a faction member (Fctnme > 0) on a map whose DeathPenalty is X (the map's PvP flag CanPeeVeePee is X) drops its own faction's head on the death pixel, created from nothing (DropAnItem; no bag slot). Not in RunDeathScript2.

exile.rule: After the death stat penalty (whether or not it fired), on the new HPmax: below the faction's threshold → Fctnme, Fctcnt and the bonuses 0, the text, save; no LeaveGroup

turnIn.rule: QuestGive to Angela, Trianus or Corin with an item containing ' Head': the named slot must contain '<item>-', then one is removed from the first bag slot 1-15 containing '<item>-'; a head whose name contains the leader's own faction word gets ownHead and nothing else; any other head gets rivalHead (aqs), then 1 power moves from the rival to the leader's faction if the rival is > 0, the join message (mgfct, wrfct, adfct) is sent regardless, the powers are written and factnrtrn goes to the giver
turnIn.ownHead: {NPC} says "A fallen member...I'll be sure to dispose of this so that our rivals don't see our weakness."
turnIn.rivalHead: {NPC} says "You have done well in slaying one of our foes."

sayFaction.rule: SayFaction <leader>: strictly highest power → absolute, else strictly lowest → weak, else fine; sent as aqs (the asker's map hears it). 1.6's lines had no closing quote; SSO closes them.
sayFaction.weak: {NPC} says "We are very weak, I fear that we may be destroyed."
sayFaction.absolute: {NPC} says "We are currently in absolute power."

wanted.text: *** You are now wanted for the murder of {NAME}.

pardoning.rule: /Pardon <word 2>, immortal only; anyone else's line is swallowed

flagRule.rule: After the death's HP reset and 80-tick wait: if the victim's gnL = 0 and LastToHitMe is not the victim and not a line 1-60 of mlists, IWMD goes to LastToHitMe. RunDeathScript2 (Lightning) sends it too. Arena (6P) deaths exit earlier.

give.rule: GiveNPC sends QuestGive '<NPC>:<item>:<slot>' unless the WorldEdit MONSTER field contains the NPC's name. Quests.txt lines 1-40: the last line containing '<NPC>:<item>' wins; none → sorry (sqa, the giver only). Else one is taken from the first slot 1-15 containing '<item>-', the line's item 3 is added (InvAdd's stacking; a full bag reuses the slot just taken from), thanks (aqs), and the line is replaced by FindNewQuest unless the NPC is a faction leader.
give.thanks: {NPC} says "Wow thanks, just what I needed. Here take this reward!"
give.sorry: {NPC} says "I'm sorry but I don't need that."

say.rule: SayQuest n1:n2:n3:n4 (on-screen slots 180-183, less names the MONSTER field contains, Pig and Cow): per name, if Quests.txt contains it, one 'bring' per line 1-40 containing it (slot 1 by sqa, slots 2-4 by aqs); else 'nothing' by aqs. 'bring' has no closing quote; 'nothing' no full stop. SSO: one 'bring' per line naming the NPC exactly, every reply by aqs, 'bring' closes its quote and 'nothing' ends with a full stop.
say.bring: {NPC} says "Bring me a {ITEM} quickly and I'll reward you."
say.nothing: {NPC} says "Sorry but I don't need anything right now."

sanitiser.rule: For each character, in this order, a forward pass over characters 1-100 deletes it; after a deletion the next character is skipped (it moved into the deleted place), so of two adjacent ones one survives. Then remove the first word if it is the, twice; remove one leading space; repeat the first-word check once more and remove one more leading space. The comparison ignores case.
